lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill area, showing a relatively uniform 2D grid spacing in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern of local maxima across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple linear features run horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance above to shadow below, indicating raised structural ridges.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits exhibits a significantly higher density of smaller, more randomly distributed high-luminance punctations compared to the ordered rows on the flank.
